prose: Nikkei Asia reports AI-linked Asian markets plunged Friday after the Wall Street tech selloff, as investors feared Democrats could delay US data-center construction after their midterm sweep. Taiwan's Taiex had a record intraday point drop, Kospi fell as much as 8.7% (Korea Exchange imposed a circuit breaker) and the Nikkei fell 6.7%.
highlights: Kospi down as much as 8.7%; circuit breaker triggered
Nikkei down 6.7%; Taiex record intraday point drop
Cause: fear of data-center delays after the Democratic win
